detail: Developer-ready synthetic source/activity data plus derived outputs for the Philippine Climate Data Portal PoC.
ALL added EMB/MGB records are synthetic demonstration data; none are official DENR/EMB/MGB/CCC/UNDP statistics.
Keep source/activity tables separate from derived inventory outputs. Dashboard values must expose source dataset, record count, method, QA/QC status and data status.
Replace synthetic tables one-for-one with agency-curated feeds while preserving contracts and provenance.
